skills.title: elaichi
skills.whenToUse: Someone asks what Elaichi is, how to do something in it, where a screen or setting lives, or what one of its words means. Also the routing table when you are not sure which Elaichi skill covers a question.

skills.title: elaichi-api
skills.whenToUse: Writing or reviewing code that calls api.elaichi.ai — scripts, integrations, provisioning, or a UI over Elaichi. Read before constructing the first request.

skills.title: elaichi-clients
skills.whenToUse: Someone is setting up an AI client against Elaichi, pasting an MCP endpoint, editing mcp.json, or reporting that their client connected but shows no tools or is missing one.

skills.title: elaichi-connections
skills.whenToUse: Someone is connecting a product account, sharing one with a team, reconnecting a broken connection, transferring ownership, offboarding a member, or building a custom connector.

skills.title: elaichi-conventions
skills.whenToUse: Load whenever calling, configuring, or reasoning about anything at api.elaichi.ai or an Elaichi MCP endpoint. Read before constructing a URL, an id, or a paged request.

skills.title: elaichi-governance
skills.whenToUse: Someone asks who can do what, why an action was refused, how to block a connector or tool, what a role grants, how to read the audit log, or how to set up SSO or SCIM.

skills.title: elaichi-mcp
skills.whenToUse: An Elaichi MCP server is attached and you need to act on the user's connected SaaS accounts, or explain why a tool is missing, refused, or asking which account to use. Read before the first search_tools call.

skills.title: elaichi-toolboxes
skills.whenToUse: Someone is building, sharing or debugging a toolbox, template or synthetic tool, deciding between a toolbox and a template, or asking what happens when they share one with a colleague.
